data: In this course, we study the wave properties of light such as interference, polarization, and diffraction in more depth. It includes the study of interferometry methods, working principles of diffraction gratings, lasers and holography. Much of it finds applications in photonics, a technology based on the utilization of light radiation. Through the lab, one will find the correlation between theory and practice and learn how to derive theories from experimental approaches within a laboratory environment.
